# E2E Test Scenarios

Write end-to-end test scenarios for critical user journeys.

## Template
- Given: initial state and preconditions
- When: user actions
- Then: expected outcomes

## Critical Journeys
1. User registration and login
2. Search and filter results
3. Create and edit items
4. Payment processing
5. Error recovery flows

## Guidelines
- Test happy paths first
- Include one failure scenario per journey
- Keep tests independent
- Use page object pattern
